mapper.sql: SELECT sd.store_doc_idx AS storeDocIdx, sd.store_idx AS storeIdx, sd.file_name AS fileName, sd.stored_name AS storedName, sd.file_size AS fileSize, sd.content_type AS contentType, sd.attachment_base_date AS attachmentBaseDate, CAST(sd.attached_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS attachedAt, CAST(sd.modified_at AS TIMESTAMP) AS modifiedAt, sd.modified_by AS modifiedBy, um.user_name AS modifiedByNm, sd.deleted_yn AS deletedYn FROM store_doc sd LEFT JOIN user_mst um ON um.user_id = sd.modified_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO store_doc ( store_idx, file_name, stored_name, file_size, content_type, attachment_base_date, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{storeIdx}, #{fileName}, #{storedName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{attachmentBaseDate}, #{modifiedBy} )
